# Inspect columns of Source 0:
# ['Text Date', 'Value Date', 'Zip Code', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']

# Output path

# Save to CSV without the index

import pandas as pd

# Read source data
source0 = pd.read_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_46/training_0.csv', index_col=0)

# Extract 'Date' column from 'Text Date' by stripping any trailing spaces/newlines and keep as string
# The 'Text Date' column looks like 'Jul_2007', which matches the target 'Date' format
source0['Date'] = source0['Text Date'].astype(str).str.strip()

# Select relevant columns and rename to match target schema
df = source0[['Date', 'Water Use', 'Power Use']]

# Group by 'Date' and sum the numeric columns to aggregate multiple entries per date
result = df.groupby('Date', as_index=False).agg({'Water Use': 'sum', 'Power Use': 'sum'})

# Ensure column types match target schema
result['Date'] = result['Date'].astype(str)
result['Water Use'] = result['Water Use'].astype(float)
result['Power Use'] = result['Power Use'].astype(int)

# Write output
result.to_csv('autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_46/target_multisource_critique_history.csv', index=False)
